svg.title: Release, when you start it
svg.desc: The steps in order, with who does each. You: start Release prep; Gather: changes since the last tag; Claude: drafts the notes, README, policy; Prepare: version, checks, README pictures; Beacon: opens the PR Kitden X.Y.Z; You: review and merge; Beacon: tags vX.Y.Z; Build, test: tests, PyPI, GitHub release; Beacon: release branch, Homebrew PR; MCP Registry: and a table of every store; Kettle: daily: Homebrew formula current; Lantern: daily: an issue if a store is behind.
